title: Plugin Catalog
description: v1/index.json, the merged document nginx-ui hosts fetch. Mirrors internal/plugin.CatalogDocument in nginx-ui, including the per-platform downloads RFC 0001 added to each entry's releases (plugin-spec/spec/rfcs/0001-per-platform-packages.md; see schema/entry.schema.json's release/download defs). Generated by scripts/build-index.mjs from plugins/*.json — do not hand edit.

schema_version.description: Matches internal/plugin.CatalogSchemaVersion. A host that does not recognize this value refuses the whole document.

name.description: Name of the catalog a host shows for this source (plugin-spec PKG-30).

icon.description: Square image a host shows for this source (plugin-spec PKG-30).
